input_contract.required_checkout: Clean GitHub checkout of exact R47 PR head; preserve uncommitted user files and do not reset/destructively clean them.
read_authority: R43-R46 theory/mocks and exact head commits
Current production source paths before any patch
input_contract.source_hashing: Recompute SHA256 from local bytes; compare against immutable source manifest. Never copy a hash into a receipt without reading the bytes.

mutation_gates.G0: Confirm exact branch/head and working-tree state; no mutation before clean identity receipt.
mutation_gates.G1: Read target modules and their callers/tests; no speculative wrappers or guessed APIs.
mutation_gates.G2: Write a failing minimal test for each intended behavior before implementation where feasible.
mutation_gates.G3: Only mutate files listed in the active turn's write_set. Keep source inputs immutable and outside Git.
mutation_gates.G4: Run unit and negative tests; record stdout/stderr/exit code; never record PASS without execution.
mutation_gates.G5: Run physical/mathematical checks independently of software unit tests.
mutation_gates.G6: Run source/byte/semantic identity checks on outputs and configs.
mutation_gates.G7: Update the claim ledger only for claims whose specific gates passed.
mutation_gates.G8: Push only the active feature branch; never merge, force push or rewrite history.
mutation_gates.G9: Create a draft PR/update existing R47 PR only after readback and test receipts are saved.

anti_drift_audit: Do not reinterpret x,Q,Pi,F,G_F as independent likelihood factors.
Do not replace the current exact physical target with scalar x_C.
Do not infer sigma_ab(t0) from integrated B_* without a physical history map.
Do not claim E/B prediction from equation (2.1).
Do not call Bianchi-I an all-Bianchi template.
Do not assign Bianchi V/VIIh parameters without their own curvature/transfer response.
Do not call a BipoSH anomaly a Bianchi signal without a physical kernel mapping.
Do not mix Planck PR3/FFP10 and PR4/NPIPE maps or mocks under one source ID.
Do not count split maps, frequencies, component-separation products or tensor summaries as independent skies.
Do not use an isotropic C_ell-only likelihood to claim full phase-sensitive low-ell morphology.
Do not re-use R42 posterior values until raw bytes, source operators, covariance and chain convergence are reproduced.
Do not hardcode Ellis-Baldwin coefficients, Gaia scales, shear transfer, optical depth or E/B zeros in production operators.
Do not infer Gaia B1 cosmic vorticity without VLBI/ICRF frame spin tie.
Do not claim local boost/global tilt discrimination from a single dipole vector.
Do not change data cuts, masks, priors, parameter transforms, alpha, target estimands or feature definitions after looking at results without a new analysis version.

resource_policy.download: Stage manifests and small files before maps/simulation sets; estimate storage and keep raw inputs immutable.
resource_policy.sampling: Run a one-probe likelihood fixture and short pilot first; use checkpointed chains and predeclared Rhat/ESS limits.
resource_policy.parallelism: Parallelize independent map transforms/injection batches only after preserving deterministic seeds, source identity and bounded memory.
resource_policy.stop: If a required simulation/covariance/transfer provider is absent, stop only the affected claim lane and continue independent theory/observables.
